coordinate_units: x/y studs from rear-left outer corner; z plate heights from bottom
name: Fern & Steam

steps.description: On a flat surface, lay the eight black plates edge to edge. They are loose until the next step; do not lift them yet.
steps.title: Lay out the foundation

steps.description: Press the tan layer onto the black layer. The offset seams join the foundation into a single assembly. Finish all 15 tan plates before lifting.
steps.title: Lock the base together

steps.description: Lay the light grey tiles in a stepped path from the front entrance toward the tea counter. Keep the marked areas studded for furniture and plants.
steps.title: Lay the courtyard path

steps.description: Add the four white corner posts, low back/side walls and the first course of the tea counter. The open side faces the path.
steps.title: Raise the kiosk, course 1

steps.description: Repeat the post and wall positions one brick higher; complete the second and final course of the tea counter.
steps.title: Raise the kiosk, course 2

steps.description: Raise the posts and back/side walls one more course. Add the brown counter plate, the narrow back shelf, and the white counter trim.
steps.title: Finish the wall and counter

steps.description: Add two grey supports, the brown seat plate, the front seat tiles and the upright backrest. The bench faces the front edge.
steps.title: Make the courtyard bench

steps.description: Add the small white table pedestal with brown top, then three brown planters capped with green plates.
steps.title: Add table and planters

steps.description: Attach the leaves and flowers at the marked studs. BOTH mug handles point REARWARD: the counter mug clears the white trim, and the table mug clears its neighboring stud.
steps.title: Plant the garden and serve tea

steps.description: Add two more white bricks to each of the four posts. Complete all four posts to the same height.
steps.title: Raise the pergola posts

steps.description: Fit the two brown 1 x 8 plates left-to-right across the front and rear pairs of posts. Support the posts while pressing the beam ends.
steps.title: Fit the pergola beams

steps.description: Lay five brown 1 x 6 plates front-to-back across both beams. Keep the intentional gaps between slats. Review the completed model before lifting it by its base.
steps.title: Fit the five roof slats
